transcript.text: Good afternoon, everyone. We have 120 returned servo drives from a customer for possible remanufacture. Let's go through the disposition huddle checklist. I'd like to hear from Quality, Environmental Health and Safety, and Remanufacturing in turn with your go-or-no-go updates before I sign the work order. Who would like to start?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: Quality update for the disposition huddle: I've completed the serial-number reconciliation. Exactly 96 of the 120 returned servo drives have complete service histories and are eligible for remanufacture. The remaining exactly 24 lack traceability and must remain quarantined. Please note this reconciliation is still in the quality review queue and has not yet reached your release packet, Elena, so I'm providing it here as my formal checklist update.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: EHS update for the disposition huddle: My battery-screening inspection found swollen lithium backup cells in exactly 18 of the 120 returned servo drives. Those 18 drives require a certified isolation procedure lasting exactly 2 hours before any remanufacturing work can begin. My inspection worksheet is awaiting attachment to the EHS case. This is my formal checklist update.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: Remanufacturing update for the disposition huddle: My cell-capacity assessment confirms the remanufacturing cell can process the 96 traceable drives in exactly 16 hours once the battery isolation is complete. I have reserved that 16-hour work period on the cell board, but I have not yet entered it in the production schedule. This is my formal checklist update.
transcript.speaker: A4

96 traceable drives require exactly 16 hours reserved processing duration; Jon must enter this 16-hour work period in the production schedule before work release.
